description: First-person grid dungeon crawler in the spirit of Wizardry and Indie Odyssey. Step tile by tile, turn 90 degrees, random encounters plus a boss guarding the exit portal, turn-based party combat (attack, spell, defend, flee), chests that heal, minimap, illustrated story slides, victory or defeat with restart, and auto-play (P) that explores, fights and loops like an arcade attract mode.
guide:
Write only the CONFIG section. The engine reads:
- THEME: colours (0xRRGGBB for 3D, [r,g,b] for UI). wallStyle 'stone' gives
  torchlit stone and 'grid' gives neon edge strips. stripGlow, lanternLevel
  and bloom are optional brightness controls; keep neon looks dark.
- TEXT: title (12 characters or fewer looks best), subtitle, prompt, and the
  victory, defeat and sealed lines.
- STORY: 0 to 4 slides. Each one is a string under 90 characters, or
  { text, art }, where art is 'castle', 'city', 'party' or 'portal'. The engine
  draws an illustration for each slide in the theme's colours. Without art it
  uses castle or city, then party, then portal.
- PARTY: 1 to 4 members { name, hp, mp, atk, color }.
- ENEMIES: 2 to 5 { name, hp, atk, color, glow, shape: 'beast'|'spirit'|'knight' }.
  Give enemy bodies mid-bright colours so they read against dark walls. Never use
  0x000000 for walls, floor, enemies or text: pure black hides everything.
- BOSS: one enemy with boss: true.
- LAYOUT: { cols 3-9, rows 3-7, seed (any integer), loops 0-0.4, torches 4-8,
  chests 1-3 }. The engine builds a solvable maze from it; never write a MAP.
- ENCOUNTER_CHANCE (0.08 to 0.2) and SPELL_COST.

description: Third-person three-lane runner. Switch lanes with Left/Right and jump with Up/Space. The engine generates fair obstacle rows that always leave an open lane: barriers block a lane, hurdles must be jumped, pickups score with a combo multiplier, and shields absorb one hit. Speed ramps up, you have lives and a best score, and there are illustrated story slides and auto-play (P).
guide:
Write only the CONFIG section. The engine reads:
- THEME: trackStyle 'grid' (neon floor and pylons) or 'corridor' (torchlit
  walls), colours (0xRRGGBB for 3D, [r,g,b] for UI), sky [top, bottom] and
  bloom (0.3 to 1.0). Keep floors and walls dark; never use 0x000000.
- TEXT: title (14 characters or fewer looks best), subtitle, prompt, over.
- STORY: 0 to 4 slides, as strings under 90 characters or { text, art }, where
  art is 'castle', 'city', 'party' (the runner) or 'portal' (the threat).
- PLAYER: { name, color, trail }.
- HAZARDS: barrier { name, color, glow }, hurdle { name, color },
  pickup { name, color, points }, shield { name, color }. Use bright colours
  for hurdle, pickup and shield, and a glowing edge for barriers.
- DIFFICULTY: lives 1-5, startSpeed 10-20, maxSpeed 24-40, ramp 0.2-0.6,
  rowGap 12-20, minRowGap 8-12, hurdleChance 0-0.5, shieldChance 0-0.1.
Never write track or obstacle layouts: the engine generates them.

description: Top-down arena game. Move freely with arrows/WASD and dash with Space (a quick burst that makes you briefly untouchable, on a cooldown). Collect gems for a combo multiplier while enemy waves grow. Every spawn is telegraphed by a glowing floor ring a second before it appears. The rim blocks you; it never hurts. Lives, waves, best score, illustrated story slides and auto-play (P).
guide:
Write only the CONFIG section. The engine reads:
- THEME: arenaStyle 'cave' (stalagmites and lit crystals) or 'neon' (ring grid
  and pylons), colours (0xRRGGBB for 3D, [r,g,b] for UI), sky [top, bottom],
  bloom 0.3 to 1.0. Keep floors and walls dark; never use 0x000000.
- TEXT: title (14 characters or fewer looks best), subtitle, prompt, over.
- STORY: 0 to 4 slides, as strings under 90 characters or { text, art }, where
  art is 'castle' (peaks or cave teeth), 'city', 'party' (the player) or
  'portal' (the enemies' eyes).
- PLAYER: { name, color, speed 6-9 }.
- GEM: { name, color, points, onScreen 2-5 }.
- ENEMIES: 2 to 4 { name, behavior: 'chaser'|'orbiter'|'dasher', color, glow,
  speed, size 0.35-0.7 }. Chasers move at speed 2-3.5, orbiters 3-5 and
  dashers lunge at 10-15. Later waves unlock later entries, so list the
  easiest first.
- DIFFICULTY: lives 1-5, waveTime 8-15, firstWave 1-3, perWave 1-2,
  maxEnemies 8-16, dashCooldown 1-2.
Never write positions or spawn layouts: the engine generates them.
